reuse.why: Builds on getBulkBudgetCategories and shouldSkipIncomeCategory, but setBulkNMonthAvg stops calling the existing setNMonthAvg and inlines its average/sign logic instead.

duplication.why: Folding set3MonthAvg into setBulkNMonthAvg removes a copy, but the notes JOIN is added to two queries, copyPreviousMonth composes its own skip chain instead of the new shouldSkipBulkCategory, and setNMonthAvg's body is copied into setBulkNMonthAvg.

placement.why: The tag predicate and skip composition live in budget/actions.ts next to the existing skip helpers and bulk queries.

scope.why: Includes unrelated edits: a type-narrowing tweak to hasSavedTemplate, retyping getBudgetData, and rewriting set3MonthAvg/setBulkNMonthAvg beyond what the tag rule needs.

maintainability.why: The tag rule is one predicate, but month-wide actions still skip via two different compositions (shouldSkipBulkCategory vs. copyPreviousMonth's inline chain), so the next exclusion must again be added in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setBulkNMonthAvg in budget/actions.ts re-implements setNMonthAvg (getCategoryAverage + sign flip + setBudget) instead of calling it; copyPreviousMonth does not use shouldSkipBulkCategory

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth re-states shouldSkipBulkCategory as separate shouldSkipIncomeCategory + hasFixedGroupTag early returns split around the hidden/template checks

one_place.where: hasFixedGroupTag in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts is the single tag definition, used via shouldSkipBulkCategory (setZero, setLastMonthSpending, setBulkNMonthAvg) and directly by copyPreviousMonth; the group-notes JOIN is repeated in both queries
